units.note: ἀνακεκλημένων (recalled/summoned back) rendered 'detained men'; context-dependent, left as is.

findings.quote: summoning prominent men to join him; and when he arrived at Ephesus
findings.problem: Greek has a lacuna: τῶν ἐπιφανῶν ἀνδρῶν *** ἀφικόμενος δ᾽ εἰς τὴν Ἔφεσον. The English reads on as if the text were whole.
findings.proposed_fix: summoning prominent men [text missing] and, on arriving at Ephesus

findings.quote: since they were the legitimate offspring of King Antiochus
findings.problem: οὖσιν Ἀντιόχου τοῦ βασιλέως ἐκγόνοις κατὰ φύσιν: 'descendants by birth/nature' (the claim is ironic in Polybius); 'legitimate' is not in the Greek (that would be κατὰ νόμον).
findings.proposed_fix: since they were, by birth, the offspring of King Antiochus

findings.quote: He also says that Demetrius—the man who escaped from his hostage life at Rome and became king of Syria in his thirty-third year—was a heavy drinker
findings.problem: ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ τριακοστῇ is the book number attached to φησι (he says in the thirty-third book), not a regnal year; βασιλεύσαντα Σύρων just means 'who became king of the Syrians'.
findings.proposed_fix: He also says in the thirty-third book that Demetrius—the man who escaped from his hostage life at Rome and became king of Syria—was a heavy drinker

units.note: Text is Athenaeus's excerpt with corrupt-looking 'ἐκ τῆς Ῥώμη'; the book-number reading is the natural one.
